opis: A little red steam train with FIVE small wooden wagons crosses a high wooden bridge over a forest valley, seen from the side and a little from below, the whole train in the picture going from left to right. The MOLE drives the engine, leaning out of the cab, waving his cap; a puff of white steam rises from the chimney. In the second wagon the BEAR, in the fourth the OWL, both looking out happily over the valley. Far below a small river, autumn trees, a blue sky with round clouds. A feeling of a joyful journey.
